# Hopfastbridge

A swap aggregator and payments app for Arc. Compare LI.FI and Squid routes, then pay anyone on Arc with USDC.
Support ARCHITECTS: Arc USDC escrow envelopes with permanent X account verification, wallet-bound claims and funder reclaim after 30 days. Activation requires escrow deployment and X configuration. Optional agent DM delivery defaults off; private claim links can be shared directly.
Payment envelopes deduct and forward a nonrefundable 2.5% Hopfast fee at deposit; the remaining 97.5% is claimable or reclaimable. Admin recovery applies only to expired envelopes, after a seven-day public delay.
Users review every route and sign in their own wallets. Transaction hashes must be verified before reporting completion.
